title: Can occupational therapy help my child who avoids certain sounds or noises?
metaTitle: Treating Sound Sensitivity in Children | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network's qualified occupational therapists deploy desensitization techniques to help children with autism who are hypersensitive to certain sounds.
html: Certainly, we understand it can be challenging when your child is hypersensitive to certain sounds. Here, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, our experienced occupational therapists are trained in techniques catered to gradually desensitize children to the sounds or noises that bother them, aiding them in reducing their discomfort.
